# Set District Heating

## Description
This measure removes all boilers in a given hot water loop and replaces them with a District Heating object.

## Modeler Description
The District Heating object is set to autosize unless a size is input by the user.

## Measure Type
ModelMeasure

## Taxonomy


## Arguments
